# JS2ME vendor bundle

Pinned upstream: [szatkus/js2me](https://github.com/szatkus/js2me/tree/828b81b468953c34bb754b59e67c1021754e8bdb), commit `828b81b468953c34bb754b59e67c1021754e8bdb`.

JS2ME is distributed under MIT (see [LICENSE](LICENSE), copyright Tomasz Szatkowski).
The zip.js/inflate/zip-ext implementation includes Gildas Lormeau/JZlib/zlib notices and BSD-style conditions;
these original headers are retained verbatim inside `engine.js`. The original setZeroTimeout attribution to L. David Baron is also retained.
No CheerpJ, FreeJ2ME, soundfont or commercial game is distributed in this bundle.

`engine.js` is generated by `tools/bundle-js2me.py` from the pinned upstream checkout.
It contains the core, `program_zazu.js`, ZIP support and a lazy registry of upstream `js/me/*.js` definitions.
No upstream emulator UI, Worker, workers.js or universal remote.js RPC bridge is included.

Small integration changes, reproduced by the bundler:

- Replace obsolete DOMNodeInserted/Removed with explicit canvas attach/detach events from Display.
- Use the supplied game-only `js2me.rmsStorage`, not browser localStorage.
- Disable compiled-method localStorage cache via an ephemeral codeCache.
- Skip the optional StackMapTable attribute, as the interpreter does not use verifier metadata. This does not add Java 8 instruction support.
- Associate Canvas key listeners with their Canvas instance for keyRepeated.
- Reject upstream's unimplemented deleteRecord operation rather than silently reporting success.

Native integration overrides (RMS durable acknowledgements, tone, lifecycle and diagnostics) live in `javagames/vm-adapter.js`, outside the vendor file.

Rebuild:

```bash
python3 tools/bundle-js2me.py --source /path/to/pinned-js2me --out javagames/vendor/js2me/engine.js
```

This is an old partial Java ME implementation. MIDP/CLDC API coverage and commercial game compatibility must be established per game.
